accepted_plan.summary: Implement same-file Edit/Write serialization for built-in filesystem mutation tools using `ToolExecutionContext` batch/call order and canonical target path. Same-batch same-file mutations execute by `call_index`; different files remain parallel; different batches maintain per-file exclusion without distributed locking. Add focused tests for Edit/Edit order, Write+Edit order, different-file concurrency, failure release, and path equivalence.
